treatment_justification: Described as 'pre-registered partial fine-tuning protocol' (and not 'pure isolated unfreezing effect') because differential learning rates, lowered head learning rate (5e-4 vs 1e-3), bounded epochs (20 vs 25), and gradient clipping (1.0 vs None) are jointly pre-registered to ensure optimization stability during convolution block unfreezing.

comparison_table.justification: Identical lightweight CNN architecture and head projection structure
Identical ImageNet-1K pretrained weights identity for backbone initialization
Identical spatial dimensions for input tensors
Standard torchvision ImageNet channel normalization
No stochastic data augmentation in either stage to preserve paired comparability
Identical multi-class focal loss implementation operating directly on logits
Identical focusing parameter for modulating hard examples
Neither Stage 1 nor Stage 2 uses class weighting alpha; alpha is strictly null in both stages
Identical label smoothing parameter across classes
Identical mean reduction over sample losses
Decoupled weight decay optimizer used in both stages
Lowered from 1e-3 to 5e-4 to avoid destabilizing pre-trained feature representation during joint fine-tuning
Backbone was completely frozen in Stage 1; unfrozen features.12 receives 5e-5 (10x lower than head)
Identical L2 regularizer coefficient 1e-4

Both use CosineAnnealingLR, but Stage 1 sets T_max=25 with default eta_min=0.0 over 25 epochs, whereas Stage 2 sets T_max=20 with bounded eta_min=1e-6 over 20 epochs; because T_max and eta_min differ, scheduler configuration is not identical (same=false).
Stage 1 allocated 25 epochs; Stage 2 allocates 20 epochs to reduce overfitting on small cohorts
Identical 5-epoch early stopping patience window
Identical threshold for minimum macro-f1 improvement
Identical batch size across all runs
Identical checkpoint selection metric evaluated strictly on inner_validation
Gradient clipping at max_norm=1.0 added in Stage 2 to stabilize gradients through unfrozen convolution block
Deterministic standard float32 precision without automatic mixed precision
Identical seeds and deterministic CUDA backend settings
